title: veronica raoulii subsp. maccaskillii
intro: Veronica raoulii subsp. maccaskillii, commonly known as Māori tea tree or New Zealand tea tree, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It is valued for its leaves, which have been traditionally used for their medicinal properties, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Veronica raoulii subsp. maccaskillii include wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
